label: agent loop • substantial single-file app with direct delivery
query: Create a polished single-file web app at index.html: a responsive personal kanban board with three columns (Backlog, Doing, Done), an add-task form, drag-and-drop between columns, delete buttons, task counts, and localStorage persistence. Use only embedded HTML/CSS/JavaScript with no external dependencies. After writing it, run a concrete shell check that verifies the file contains the three columns and localStorage code. The workspace file itself is the deliverable.
notes: Reproduces the substantial single-file app workload from harness feedback. The explicit 8,192-token rail is shared across harnesses because Bonsai's complete tool envelope exceeds 4,096 tokens. Scores correct file delivery and verification while treating lifecycle/discovery calls as friction.
